warnings: Grid bubbles 1-8 (x) and A-E (y) are printed on S-01..S-05. Bays: x 5.50 x 7 = 38.50 (S-01 and S-02 agree); y A-B 4.00, B-C 5.00, C-D 5.00, D-E 5.00 = 19.00 (S-01 and S-02 agree). Origin A1 (top-left).

Dummies come from S-02's dimension rows (rule 4): mid-bay ticks at 2.75 in every bay (secondary beams B7), 1.50 left of grid 2 (B8, left canopy bay), 1.375 + 1.375 in the 7'-8 half bay (B8, right), edges 1.50 outside grids 1, 8 and E; y: 3.00 below A (B11), 1.50 below A (B12, right chain). S-03 adds the lower-roof canopy tips 2.00 outside grids 1 and 8 and below row E (1' -2.00, 8''' 40.50, E''' 21.00); 1' (-2.00), 1'' (-1.50) and 1''' (-1.00, S-05) share grid 1's prime sequence with the in-bay dummies 1'''' (2.75) and 1''''' (4.00).

Conflict: the top edge above row A is printed 1.75 on the left chain and 1.85 on the right chain, both apparently to the same drawn canopy edge. They differ by 0.10 m, so both are kept as lines (A'' -1.85, A''' -1.75) per rule 4 rather than picking one. The canopy edge beams B4/B10 and the canopy cantilevers were placed on A''' (-1.75, the chain printed on the side where B10/B9 are drawn); the 1.85 reading is plausible (it may run to the outer slab edge), so A'' carries a lowered score.

Dimension sweep in this run covered only the structural plans S-01 (page 16), S-02 (page 17), S-03 (page 18) S-04 (page 19) and S-05 (page 20). The architectural sheets (A-02..A-13, pages 4-15) and S-06..S-13 (pages 21-28) were NOT swept: the op04 run was cut short by the scheduled shutdown, and their dimension rows still have to be added.
Element-internal dimensions (footing sizes, beam/slab section sizes) are kept on the elements, not here.

S-04 (page 19) adds y A' -2.00 and E' 20.00 (truss tips: printed 2.00 above A and 1.00 below E) and D' 17.00 for truss T2, which no chain dimensions — measured by proportion between D and E (scaled_from_grid, lowered score). Existing dummies were re-sequenced in reading order with every ref in this house renamed (A' -2.00, A'' -1.85, A''' -1.75, A'''' 1.50, A''''' 3.00; E' 20.00, E'' 20.50, E''' 21.00).

S-05 (page 20) adds x lines at the purlin ends printed 1.00 outside grids 1 and 8: grid-1 and grid-8 dummies re-sequenced in reading order with every ref renamed (1' -2.00, 1'' -1.50, 1''' -1.00, 1'''' 2.75, 1''''' 4.00; 8' 39.50, 8'' 40.00, 8''' 40.50).
S-08 (page 23) reprints the 1-8 5.50 chain under each beam elevation (3 rows, recorded); its bar cut-off rows are element-internal and are not grid lines.

S-09 (page 24) beam elevations reprint x 4.00 + 1.50 (grid 1 to the B8 line to grid 2), the 5.50 bays, and y bays with the canopy cantilever 1.75 beyond row A (B5/1, B6/1) — recorded; this is 3 prints of 1.75 against the single 1.85 on S-02's right chain. Bar cut-off rows are element-internal.
